props.name: id
props.description:
The id for the fieldset id attribute.
If the prop is not set a random value will be generated.

props.name: name
props.description:
Name provided to child content as `sharedName` for optional usage (it will not be set on the fieldset element).
For radio inputs this is a shortcut to specify the shared name attribute at one place,
instead of repeatedly setting the name attribute on each radio input.

props.name: labelClass
props.description: The CSS classes for the label, description and error-message slot.

props.name: contentClass
props.description: The CSS classes for the default slot.

props.name: horizontal
props.description:
Aligns underlying items horizontally.
Supported by radiobuttons and chip layout.

props.name: chip
props.description: Displays radio and checkbox content with chip layout.

props.name: border
props.description: Displays a box with border around radiobuttons and checkboxes.

props.name: showDetails
props.description:
Sets visibility behaviour for details slot in selectable child items. By default details slot is not rendered.

* `never` (default) - Never show item details.
- `when-selected` - Show item details when selected.
- `always` - Always show item details.

slots.name: label
slots.description: Slot for label content. This slot is required.

slots.name: description
slots.description: Optional slot for description. See {@link FLabel} for details.

bindings.name: description-class
bindings.description: CSS classes for primary description content.

slots.name: error-message
slots.description: Slot for label content. This slot is required.

bindings.name: hasError
bindings.description: Set to true when a validation error is present

bindings.name: validationMessage
bindings.description: Descriptive validation error message for current error
